interface.longDescription: Arrange two to six supplied photos in a grid, vertical story or strip. Choose whole-photo padding or cropping, spacing and background color. No generated replacement photos. Connect to Firemoon for media processing. Media is processed by Firemoon and its providers; output links are accessible to anyone holding them. New host features have standard tool and inline-preview alternatives.
defaultPrompt: Arrange my uploaded photos into a clean collage.

publication.release_notes: Adds the existing working MCP integration to the submission and replaces review cases with reproducible supported workflows and explicit unsupported boundaries. Updates publisher attribution to Imagineers Studio Inc.

review.commerce_description: Provider-backed image, video, speech and narration processing can be billed by Firemoon. Deterministic operations do not use generative models. Purchases take place on the Firemoon website. The plugin does not execute payments, money transfers, crypto transfers or investment trades.
